summary_en: This Phase 1/1b study tests NY-ESO-1 TCR/IL-15 NK cells, which are donated natural killer cells that express a T-cell receptor against NY-ESO-1, given with chemotherapy in advanced synovial sarcoma and myxoid/round cell liposarcoma. The drugs are given by IV (vein), with fludarabine and cyclophosphamide given with the NK cells, in dose groups of up to 6 participants and up to 4 NK cell dose levels. How often and for how long doses are given is not stated. The study measures the recommended dose of NK cells, and the record also says safety and effects will be studied.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1/1b evalúa células NK de donante que expresan un receptor de células T contra NY-ESO-1, administradas junto con quimioterapia en sarcoma sinovial avanzado y liposarcoma mixoide/de células redondas. Los medicamentos se administran por IV (vena): fludarabina y ciclofosfamida junto con las células NK, en grupos de hasta 6 participantes y hasta 4 niveles de dosis de células NK. La frecuencia y la duración de las dosis no se indican en el registro. El estudio mide la dosis recomendada de células NK, y el registro también indica que se estudiarán la seguridad y los efectos.
who_for: Advanced synovial sarcoma or myxoid/round cell liposarcoma with NY-ESO-1 positive tumor
Relapsed or refractory after at least one prior line of systemic therapy with doxorubicin and/or ifosfamide (or trabectedin for liposarcoma)
ECOG performance status 0-1, age 16-80 years, weight 40 kg or more
not_for: Active hepatitis B or C, or HIV with detectable viral load
Active autoimmune disease within 12 months of enrollment
Other malignancy within the past 2 years, with listed exceptions
